other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India.
Applicant must be registered as a Construction Worker with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
Applicant must be contributing to the Board's Fund.
Applicant must not have defaulted on contribution payments for a continuous period of more than one year.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹75,000 transferred via Direct Benefit Transfer within one month of application.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attest, if required)
